scope.acceptance_gate: Do not report complete unless all 352 fixture rows have row-level venue and coordinate evidence with provenance; aggregate season/team mappings are not complete.

params.topic: Primeira Liga 2021/22-2024/25: row-level venue and WGS84 coordinate verification for 352 fixtures missing venue evidence

known_local_gap.prior_receipt_limitation: venue_by_season and stadium_coords are aggregate crosswalk evidence only; do not treat as fixture-level proof

questions: Process only the 352 listed Primeira Liga regular-season fixtures in 2021/22, 2022/23, 2023/24 and 2024/25. Preserve the exact fixture_key and return exactly one primary row per fixture.

For every fixture, verify the actual host venue used on that match date. Prefer a direct official league schedule/match page, official club match page, official stadium/club page, or an explicit season fixture page. Do not use a season + home-team venue table as the sole evidence.

When the direct match page is unavailable, inspect the home club page and its season/match history or the club Wikipedia page and the relevant season page, then cross-check with a second independent source. Clearly label whether the source is direct fixture evidence, club-page evidence, Wikipedia evidence, or secondary cross-check.

Return venue, venue_latitude, venue_longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees, plus source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256 and field_semantics for each field. The locator must identify the page section, table row, infobox or text passage supporting the value.

If a match was relocated, played at a neutral venue, or used a temporary stadium, record the fixture-specific venue and explain the relocation. Do not copy the usual home stadium without date-specific evidence.

Use Wikipedia or a club interface as an allowed evidence route, but retain the exact page URL and locator. Club identity pages alone do not prove that every fixture used the listed stadium; use them only with season/match evidence or label the row partial.

A row is complete only when fixture identity, venue, latitude and longitude are all present and each value has provenance. If any field is not evidenced, keep it NULL with status=unavailable or blocked and put the row in unresolved_queue. Never guess coordinates.

Return audit totals with expected=352, discovered, identity_matched, complete, partial, unavailable, blocked, conflicts and missing. The desired delivery is complete=352, partial=0, missing=0; if that cannot be achieved, return the unresolved rows and exact reason instead of claiming completion.

Return a row-level source list and preserve conflicts from different sources. Do not auto-resolve conflicting venue names or coordinates; place them in conflict_queue with all competing source URLs and locators.
This is football evidence only. Do not return Qimen charts, palaces, Q/F/G/I tokens, odds, probabilities, Miss labels, Outcome, Review, Gold, SQLite writes, or model conclusions.
